name: io.github.carlosbravoa/fcvm
title: fcvm
description: Disposable Firecracker microVM sandboxes for agents: run code, snapshot, fork. Needs Linux with KVM.

environmentVariables.name: FCVM_MCP_NETWORK
environmentVariables.description: Pin the network policy for every sandbox: none, or an allowlist such as @pypi,@github

environmentVariables.name: FCVM_MCP_TEMPLATE
environmentVariables.description: Template used when the agent names neither an image nor a template, e.g. python-sandbox

environmentVariables.name: FCVM_MCP_TTL
environmentVariables.description: Stop sandboxes this long after boot unless the agent sets a lifetime, e.g. 4h

environmentVariables.name: FCVM_MCP_IDLE_STOP
environmentVariables.description: Stop sandboxes that saw no exec or file operation for this long, e.g. 30m

environmentVariables.name: FCVM_MCP_SECRETS
environmentVariables.description: Names of environment variables passed into every sandbox as secrets, e.g. GITHUB_TOKEN

environmentVariables.name: FCVM_MCP_FORWARD
environmentVariables.description: Host credentials relayed into every sandbox: ssh-agent, git

environmentVariables.name: FCVM_MCP_CACHE
environmentVariables.description: 1: restricted sandboxes fetch pip and npm packages through the host's mirror

environmentVariables.name: FCVM_MCP_JAIL
environmentVariables.description: 0: don't run sandboxes under the Firecracker jailer even when it is set up

environmentVariables.name: FCVM_BIN
environmentVariables.description: Path of the fcvm command, when it isn't on PATH, in ~/.local/bin or in /usr/local/bin
